claims.text: Swallowed topical glucocorticoid: fluticasone from a multidose inhaler puffed into the mouth and swallowed (not inhaled), or budesonide 1-2 mg oral viscous slurry 30 minutes after breakfast and dinner; give at least 8 weeks.
claims.quote: If topical glucocorticoids are chosen, patients may use a multidose inhaler of fluticasone; they puff the medication into their mouth without inhaling and then swallow it. Alternatively, budesonide 1 to 2 mg oral viscous slurry can be taken 30 minutes after breakfast and 30 minutes after dinner. Fluticasone or budesonide is given for at least 8 weeks to determine efficacy.

claims.text: Dupilumab (IL-4 receptor alpha antagonist, subcutaneous; age >= 1 year and >= 15 kg)
claims.quote: Dupilumab is a biologic given by subcutaneous injection to patients ≥ 1 year of age who weigh at least 15 kg (33 lb) (2). It is a human monoclonal antibody that is an interleukin (IL)-4 receptor alpha antagonist

claims.text: for patients not responding to other medication.
claims.quote: The biologic medication dupilumab may be used in patients who do not respond to other medication therapy.
